title: Men's Hiking Boots – Grip & Support on the Trail
descriptionHtml:
Low shoes run out where the trail begins

Roots, loose stones and steep slabs – in thin sneakers you feel every sharp step through the sole, and on slippery roots it's your ankle that takes the hit.

The boot built for the terrain

A chunky sole that bites into gravel and rock, a higher shaft that supports the ankle and metal hooks that make lacing quick and secure. The suede and mesh upper keeps the weight down – the boot goes along all day without feeling like cast iron.

Features

  • Grips on gravel, rock and wet roots – chunky patterned outsole
  • Supports the ankle on uneven terrain – higher shaft with padded collar
  • The lacing stays put all day – metal hooks instead of fabric loops
  • Stands up to being dragged through the forest – reinforced toe cap that takes the knocks

Right to change your mind

You have 14 days to change your mind, counted from the day you receive the item.
